name: treehorn
description: Discover short daily audio shows: catch up on news, explore history and science, or find something to learn in the time you have.

interface.longDescription: Find something worth listening to on your next walk or coffee break. Treehorn has short daily audio shows on news, history, science, books and culture. Catch up on the news, explore something you’re curious about, or find an episode that fits the time you have. Browse recommendations with descriptions and durations, then follow a link to listen on Treehorn.
defaultPrompt: I have seven minutes. Find me something fascinating to listen to.
Find a short listen to catch me up on AI.
Find me a surprising story from history.

positive.prompt: Find me something interesting to learn in under seven minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Use category education and max_minutes 7; recommend a matching episode with its actual duration and listening link.

positive.prompt: What is the latest Cyber World News episode?
positive.expected_behavior: Filter by Cyber World News. Report the publication date, title and episode description with a listening link. Do not invent details beyond the description.

positive.prompt: Find a Treehorn episode about blood transfusions.
positive.expected_behavior: Search concise topic keywords in education; return relevant released episodes and listening links.
Return the released episode title, show, date, duration and listening link.

positive.prompt: Find a Treehorn episode about quuxglorp12345.
positive.expected_behavior: State that no matching episodes were found. Do not invent an episode.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose drafts or transcripts; explain that the plugin only discovers released episodes.
Do not claim to cancel anything. The plugin has no account-management tools; direct the user to Treehorn support if useful.
Do not initiate a purchase or promote an upgrade. This plugin only searches released audio.

review.commerce_description: Catalog discovery only. No purchases, subscription upgrades or account mutations.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search released episodes, browse the latest lineup, and retrieve episode details with listening links.
